children: Open Text amended its cash tender offer for a portion of its 3.875% senior notes due 2028, reducing the maximum tender amount to $300 million and extending key deadlines.
Reduced Aggregate Maximum Tender Amount for the 3.875% 2028 notes from $450M to $300M, lowering the portion to be repurchased.
Extended Withdrawal Deadline to Sept 30, 2026, 5:00 p.m. NYC time, giving holders additional time to decide.
Moved Price Determination Date to Sept 30, 2026, 3:00 p.m. NYC time and extended Expiration Date to Sept 30, 2026, 5:00 p.m.
Settlement for accepted tenders is expected on Oct 2, 2026 (T+2); other tender terms and the Financing Condition remain unchanged.
